portable_boundaries: Native D3D shader and original game were examined statically; no original executable or native GPU screenshot was executed for this receipt.

Dc4Blur uses a60Hz clock, one shared animation queue for the uniformly addressed object group, and point-sampled integer-rounded RGBA. Exact GPU subpixel filtering, per-object input factors and skip acceleration remain approximations.

The standalone ARGB filter accepts a whole texture. Filtering a scene after composition rather than every native render object changes occlusion edges and texture-coordinate scales. The renderer must explicitly declare its chosen approximation, and must leave UI outside the blurred stage.
Zero B2 endpoint/duration is absent from the audited game and can yield native infinities/division by zero; the portable helper rejects these unreviewed calls explicitly.

The portable78 move translates built panel geometry on elapsed updates rather than reproducing the native floating draw-origin pipeline. Native animation frame jitter and construction during an active origin animation are not claimed identical.
